blocks.text: Aap jandaron ki paanch kingdoms se waqif hain. Kuch aisi makhlooq (creatures) bhi hain jin ki cellular organisation nahin hoti lekin phir bhi zinda cheezon ki kuch khususiyat dikhati hain. Viruses aise jandaron ke numainde (representatives) hain.

Viruses intehai chhote infectious agents hain jo sirf electron microscope se dekhe ja sakte hain. In ka size 20 nm (parvovirus) se 250 nm (pox viruses) tak hota hai, aksar bacteria se 10 se 1000 guna chhota, isi liye yeh filter paper ke pores se guzar jate hain.

Virus ka markazi (central) core us ka genome hai, jo nucleic acid, DNA ya RNA, se banta hai. Core ke gird ek protein ka ghilaaf (coat) hota hai jise capsid kehte hain, jo virus ko us ki muqarrar (definite) shakal deta hai. Capsid protein ke subunits se banta hai jinhen capsomeres kehte hain; capsomeres ki tadaad aur qisam har virus ki khaas pehchan hai. Core aur capsid ko mila kar nucleocapsid kehte hain.

Sirf kuch animal viruses mein nucleocapsid ke upar ek aur membrane hoti hai jise envelope kehte hain. Envelope lipid se bharpoor membrane hai jo host cell se li jati hai. Jin viruses mein envelope nahin hota unhen naked viruses kehte hain.

blocks.title: Capsomeres ginna
blocks.text: Herpes virus, jo cold sores aur chickenpox karta hai, ke capsid mein 162 capsomeres hote hain. Adenovirus, jo aam zukaam (common cold) karta hai, mein 252.

Viruses ki aam shakal o soorat mein bara tanawwo (diversity) hai. Animal aur plant viruses polyhedral (kai sides wale) ya helical ho sakte hain. Bacterial viruses, yani bacteriophages, cubical, icosahedral (20 faces wale), helical ya complex ho sakte hain, jin mein polyhedral head aur rod jaisi tail hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch virus shaklein: helical virus jis ke andar nucleic acid ka coil; icosahedral virus; complex bacteriophage head aur tail fibres ke saath; enveloped virus jis ke capsid ke gird lipid envelope aur spikes; naked (bina envelope) icosahedral virus.
blocks.caption: Viruses ki shaklon mein tanawwo (chapter 1 ka model, labels ke saath; Figure 2.10 ke mutabiq).
blocks.long_description: Baen se daen: helical virus jo nucleic acid ki rod ke gird capsomeres ka spiral hai; icosahedral virus jis ke bees tikoni faces hain; bacteriophage jis ka icosahedral head seedhi tail par hai aur tail fibres hain; enveloped virus jis ka icosahedral capsid gol lipid envelope ke andar hai jis par glycoprotein spikes hain; aur naked icosahedral virus jis par envelope nahin.

blocks.text: Bacteriophages viruses ka ek mutanawwa group hain jo bacteria par hamla karte hain. Yeh sab se pecheeda (complex) viruses mein se hain. Escherichia coli ke sab se mashhoor phages T-phages hain, jin ki kai qismein hain. T4 phage head aur tail par mushtamil hai. Head ek lamba pyramidal (do tikonon ka ek mushtarak base), hexagonal (chhe sides wala), prism jaisi banawat hai. Us ka capsid proteins ka hai aur core mein lamba double-stranded DNA hai. Head se seedhi tail juri hai. Tail mein androoni core aur bahar ki sheath hai, dono mukhtalif proteins ki. Ek neck sheath ko head se jorta hai, aur sheath ke doosre sire par end plate hoti hai. End plate se chhe tail fibres jure hain; yeh phage ko bacterial wall se jurne mein madad dete hain. Yeh sab banawatein bhi proteins ki hain.

blocks.alt: T4 bacteriophage: lamba hexagonal prism head jis mein lipta hua DNA, chhoti neck, seedhi tail jis mein outer sheath ke andar inner core, neeche end plate aur chhe mure hue tail fibres.
blocks.caption: Bacteriophage, T4 phage, ki banawat (Figure 2.11 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Upar head hai, nokeele siron wala lamba chhe-side prism, jis ke andar double-stranded DNA ka coil hai. Us ke neeche tang neck seedhi tail se jurti hai. Tail chauri sheath ki tarah hai jis ke darmiyan patla core neeche tak jata hai. Neeche chapti end plate par chhe joron wale tail fibres bahar ki taraf phaile hain.

blocks.title: Phages bator carriers
blocks.text: Bacteriophages genetic engineering mein carriers ke tor par istemal hote hain. Matloob (of interest) gene bacteriophage ke DNA mein daala jata hai, jo use nishana bacterial cell tak le jata hai. Jab virus apna DNA bacterial chromosome mein shamil karta hai to matloob gene bhi bacterial DNA ka hissa ban jata hai. Aise transgenic bacteria (jin ke genome mein kisi doosre jandar ka DNA ho) ko ugaa kar gene ki copies aur matloob protein hasil ki ja sakti hai.

Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) retroviruses se taalluq rakhta hai, jo animal viruses ka ek khaas group hai. Retroviruses ke capsid ke andar RNA hota hai, aur yeh banawatein lipid se bharpoor envelope mein lipti hoti hain. Envelope par glycoprotein spikes hote hain jo virus ko apna nishana pehchanne aur us se jurne mein madad dete hain. Retroviruses gol (spherical) hote hain, taqreeban 100 nm qutar (diameter) ke. In ki sab se numayan khususiyat ek khaas enzyme, reverse transcriptase, hai jo reverse transcription karata hai: single-stranded RNA ulti taraf DNA ki ek strand mein transcribe hota hai, aur phir enzyme us DNA strand se DNA ka double helix mukammal karta hai.

blocks.alt: Cross-section mein gol HIV particle: bahar glycoprotein spikes wali lipid envelope, andar cone jaisa capsid jis mein RNA ki do strands aur reverse transcriptase ke molecules.
blocks.caption: HIV ki banawat (Figure 2.12 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Bahar wala daira lipid envelope hai, jo host cell se li gai hai, jis se gol sire wale glycoprotein spikes bahar nikle hain. Andar cone jaisa capsid bana hai, aur us ke andar RNA ki do strands aur kai chhote reverse transcriptase molecules. Labels envelope, glycoprotein spikes, capsid, RNA aur reverse transcriptase batate hain.

blocks.text: HIV bimari AIDS (acquired immunodeficiency syndrome) ka zimmedar hai. AIDS mareez ke immune system ko kamzor karta hai. Yeh bimari jaan-leva hai kyunke doosri viral aur bacterial infections se bachao ke liye immune system ke baghair koi zinda nahin reh sakta. Yeh bimari pehli baar 1981 mein report hui, aur pehle mareez homosexual the; baad mein AIDS ghair-homosexual mareezon mein bhi mili jinhen AIDS ke mareezon se khoon ya khoon ki cheezein di gai theen. 1984 mein pata chala ke AIDS karne wala agent ek virus hai, aur 1986 mein is virus ko Human Immunodeficiency Virus ka naam diya gaya. HIV host-specific hai: yeh bandaron (monkeys) mein barh sakta hai lekin un mein AIDS nahin karta.

blocks.title: HIV kahan se aaya
blocks.text: Mahireen (experts) ne nateeja nikala hai ke HIV Africa ke janglon mein jangli chimps mein paida hua. Shawahid (evidence) batate hain ke is virus ki ek shakal bandar ke kaatne ya bandar ka gosht aur dimagh khane se insaani nasal mein dakhil hui aur HIV bani.

blocks.prompt: Nucleocapsid kya hai, aur enveloped viruses mein kaunsi extra teh hoti hai aur kahan se aati hai?
blocks.explanation: Nucleocapsid nucleic acid core aur us ke protein capsid ko mila kar kehte hain. Enveloped viruses (sirf kuch animal viruses) host cell ki membrane se li gai lipid envelope rakhte hain; jin mein yeh nahin hoti woh naked hain.

items: Viruses ki cellular organisation nahin; yeh 20-250 nm ke hain, sirf electron microscope se nazar aate hain, aur filter paper se guzar jate hain.
Virus capsomeres ke capsid mein nucleic acid core (DNA ya RNA) hai; core aur capsid mil kar nucleocapsid; kuch animal viruses host se li gai lipid envelope rakhte hain, baqi naked hain.
Shaklein: plant aur animal viruses mein polyhedral ya helical; bacteriophages mein cubical, icosahedral, helical ya complex.
T4 phage: prism jaisa head double-stranded DNA ke saath, neck, core aur sheath wali tail, end plate aur chhe tail fibres; phages genetic engineering mein genes le jate hain.
HIV gol enveloped retrovirus hai jis mein RNA, glycoprotein spikes aur reverse transcriptase hain; yeh AIDS karta hai, jo 1981 mein report hua, 1984 mein virus sabit hua aur 1986 mein naam mila.
